verifyDelivery.title: Public verification
verifyDelivery.lead: Check that the record of an aid delivery has not been altered since it was written to the blockchain.
verifyDelivery.privacy: This check shows no personal data: it only compares digital fingerprints of the delivery record.

verified.title: Delivery verified
verified.text: The current record matches the one written to the blockchain: it was not altered.

mismatch.title: The record does not match
mismatch.text: The current record differs from the one written to the blockchain. The data may have changed after the delivery.

notFound.title: We could not find this delivery
notFound.text: There is no delivery registered with this code. Check that the link is complete.

unavailable.title: We could not reach the blockchain
unavailable.text: The network is not answering right now. Try again in a few minutes.

error.title: Could not verify
error.text: There was a problem checking the delivery. Please try again.

verifyDelivery.checkingText: Comparing the record with the blockchain.
